neighbours.label: Reference domains for quantified claims: relative-clause restrictors, outcome denominators, and event-condition subjects
fire: She succeeds at everything she attempts.
He has won every race that he entered.
Most scientists I have spoken to agree with the result.
Forty percent of the people they tested carried the antibody.
The team won nine of its twelve matches.
The film received six prizes from eight nominations.
The experiment worked on its first attempt.
The army defeats its opponents whenever they attack.
quiet: He entered a race and won.
I have spoken to scientists about the result.
They tested the people for the antibody.
The army and its opponents attacked at dawn.

predictions: At least 5/8 fire, at most 1/8 near misses. The relative, denominator, ordinal and conditional branches are scored separately in the report; a pooled pass does not establish monosemanticity.
notes: Revised after the initial relative-only label missed strong numerical and event-condition cases. These are new authored sentences, not copied from the measured bank. The label names multiple candidate jobs rather than claiming a single validated computation.
